subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about retargeting abandoning shoppers back to checkout at {Brand}. The Metapack and Retail Economics 2026 benchmark puts UK AI shopping discovery near 50 million monthly ChatGPT shopping-intent visits, so more demand lands cold, while DTC paid CPAs run between $30 and $50, with a Meta median of $38 (Triple Whale 2026). At that cost a returning buyer is your cheapest sale, the lane eBay UK keeps working. We hold out a control group so the purchases we bill read as incremental to your organic returners. Worth comparing?
angle: fresh angle: AI-shopping discovery shift (Metapack/Retail Economics 2026, sourced) + UK DTC paid CPA band $30-$50
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce retargeting UK: acknowledges 2nd follow-up and references prior; fresh angle = timely development (Metapack/Retail Economics 2026 AI-shopping discovery, ~50M monthly ChatGPT shopping-intent visits) + REAL sourced CPA band (DTC ecommerce paid CPA ~$30-$50, Meta median $38.19, Triple Whale, verified) with eightx as UK-context corroboration; rotates peer to eBay UK (from candidates); MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced with no figure (no illustrative flag); exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native English; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'; no hedge before a number.
